alerts.title: Successful SSH login after repeated failures
alerts.description: Login succeeded for 'deploy' (password) after 14 failed attempts in 900s (14 against this account). Credentials may be compromised.
alerts.recommendation: Treat as an incident: check what the session did, reset the account's credentials, kill active sessions, and review other logins from this IP.

alerts.title: Distributed attack on one account ('root')
alerts.description: 24 failed logins against 'root' from 6 different IPs within 300s. No single IP crossed the per-IP threshold, which is how attackers try to stay unnoticed.
alerts.recommendation: Do not auto-lock the account (attackers can abuse lockouts to deny service). Tell the account owner, require MFA or key-only login, and check whether this account had a successful login from any of these IPs.

alerts.title: Server-wide surge of failed SSH logins
alerts.description: 120 failed logins from 40 IPs across 15 accounts within 300s. Internet-facing servers always get some background noise, so compare with your normal level before acting.
alerts.recommendation: Low priority. Check whether this is above your usual level, confirm that password login is disabled or rate limited, and consider restricting SSH to a VPN.
